about: tool-discipline-start-2026-11 and its Hermes rerun: whether gstack's start hook gets OpenClaw and Hermes on Opus 5.5 to actually start the matching gstack skill (the preregistered verdicts in report.md and report-hermes-r2.md).

not_rebuilt.what: The per-trial run reports (results/report.md and results-hermes-r2/report.md)
not_rebuilt.reason: scripts/gsta-135/report.ts needs the --summary file that discovery.sh wrote from the shard's ledger at the end of the run, and that file was never committed (only its text inside report.md).

not_rebuilt.what: The per-trial evidence and cells (results*/cells.jsonl, evidence/ and register-checks.jsonl)
not_rebuilt.reason: scripts/gsta-135/evidence.ts builds them from the harness transcripts and Hermes state.db files, which were not committed; cells.jsonl is the input the verdicts above are rebuilt from.
scripts/tool-discipline/clean-arm-audit.ts reads each trial's Hermes state.db and agent.log, which were not committed.

not_rebuilt.what: The Hermes approval finding (results/hermes-approval/blocks.jsonl, detector.json and tirith-download.json)
not_rebuilt.reason: They were counted from each trial's Hermes agent.log, which was not committed, and no script in this repository writes them.

not_rebuilt.what: The runtime gates (runtime-preflight.json, results-hermes-r2/clean-arms.jsonl and tirith-fence.jsonl)
not_rebuilt.reason: They come from preflight and fence checks that start the harness containers (Docker), not from committed files.
